summary: Celularity Inc filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $1M secured loan agreement with an affiliate of a 5% shareholder, and the resignation of director Vincent LeVien. The loan is at 4% interest, maturing in 30 days or upon receipt of financing proceeds. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is described. The director resignation appears routine without abrupt circumstances, so this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
